maddeler.e:
ارتضخن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخْنَ (irtaḍaḵna) /ir.ta.dˤax.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخْنَ (urtuḍiḵna) /ur.tu.dˤix.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اِرْتَضِخْنَ (irtaḍiḵna) /ir.ta.dˤix.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
